newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end 1.55 pct up at new life high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end 1.55 pct up at new life high.

text.p: Austrian shares end 19.75 points or 1.55 percent higher at new life high of 1,290.11 driven by oil and chemicals group OMV, traders say. Next target seen 1,300
* Leading gainer AMS up 3.68 pct at 930 ats
* Top decliner Wolford WOLV.VI, down 2.28 pct at 1,241 ats
* June ATX future up 20 points at 1,289.0 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
